summary: Tested the new OAuth 2.1 feature for the ORA Chat MCP server (discovery, DCR, PKCE authorize/consent/token, MCP with OAuth token, refresh rotation + theft detection) AND regression-checked the pre-existing Bearer-key MCP path. All 22 backend OAuth tests (backend/tests/test_oauth_mcp.py) and all 13 pre-existing Bearer-key MCP tests (backend/tests/test_mcp_ora_chat_admin.py) pass against the live preview backend. Verified the Vite-served bare-root .well-known JSON docs (application/json content-type, correct issuer/endpoints/S256), verified the pre-existing unrelated /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (auremcto.com general API declaration) was NOT modified. Frontend spot-checked: (1) /oauth/authorize while logged out correctly 302s to /login?next=%2Foauth%2Fauthorize... (admin gate reused), (2) after admin login, an expired/bogus consent_id shows the styled 'This authorization request has expired' consent page (data-testid=oauth-authorize-page rendered), and (3) /admin/api-keys renders the ora-mcp-card with the new ora-oauth-box (AS metadata + Resource metadata URLs, Copy buttons, registered clients table).
critical_code_review_comments: No new issues found. Implementation is clean: PKCE S256 verified server-side, admin-only gate enforced on /oauth/pending/{id} AND /oauth/authorize/approve, refresh-token reuse triggers whole-family revocation (theft detection), resource-mismatch on /authorize correctly redirects back to the registered redirect_uri with error=invalid_target (does not leak to untrusted URLs), non-https/non-loopback redirect_uris rejected at DCR time, WWW-Authenticate header on 401 correctly points at the bare-root PRM URL.
Pre-existing /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (auremcto.com resource declaration) confirmed untouched by this change.

Minor observation: /admin/gateway/oauth-clients response included 2 leftover 'pytest OAuth client' entries at the start of this test round — cleaned them up via /admin/gateway/oauth-clients/{id}/revoke as part of the standard test-data cleanup policy. Table is now empty.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 spot-checks: logged-out redirect, admin consent page render, admin api-keys OAuth section)

test_credentials: Admin: test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026! (POST /api/aurem-dev/auth/login) — unchanged from previous rounds.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All OAuth clients / tokens / signup accounts created during pytest and manual verification were revoked/expired at end of run. Two leftover pytest OAuth clients from an earlier main-agent test run were also revoked as cleanup — final /admin/gateway/oauth-clients list is empty ({"ok":true,"clients":[]}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: OAuth 2.1 for ORA Chat MCP is verified working end-to-end. Both test files (test_oauth_mcp.py — 22 tests, test_mcp_ora_chat_admin.py — 13 tests) are stable and can be reused as regression suites. Run them from /app/backend (NOT /app) so conftest.py's 'from services.retry_guard import ...' resolves — pytest from /app fails with ModuleNotFoundError on services (that's an env quirk, not a test bug). Known pre-existing OUT-OF-SCOPE: ask_ora_chat still returns llm_api_key_missing in preview (ORA Chat internal LLM config, unrelated to auth wiring) — the pytest for it already tolerates this shape.
